z-m-32-02.title: Mutemo 'wanza ma slopes kuti uwane −1' unotsanangura zvese nezve mitsetse yakamira here?
z-m-32-02.topic: Mitsetse yakamira nechigadzirwa che slopes dzayo
z-m-32-02.goal: Shandisa mienzaniso kutarisa kuti mutemo 'kana mitsetse yakamira, chigadzirwa che slopes dzayo i −1' unoshandiswa chete kana mitsetse yose ine slopes, uye uenzanise nzira dzekutarisa dzinosanganisirawo mitsetse isina slope.
z-m-32-02.material: Minseo akapfupisa seizvi: "Kana mitsetse miviri yakamira, chigadzirwa che slopes dzayo i −1. Saka kana chigadzirwa chisiri −1, haina kumira." Doyun akabvunza, "Saka mutsetse wakamira x=2 nemutsetse wakatwasuka y=3 haugone kuwanzwa ma slopes ayo, saka haina kumira, handizvo here?" Fungidzira kuti mutsetse wese unotambanuka zvakananga uye usina kuguma kumativi ose maviri, uye mayuniti emaaxes ecoordinate akafanana. (x=2 i mutsetse une mutengo we x unogara uri 2, mutsetse wakamira unofanana ne y-axis. y=3 i mutsetse wakatwasuka unofanana ne x-axis.)
z-m-32-02.prereq.0: Zvinoreva slope yemutsetse y=mx+n (linear functions dzechikoro chepakati)
z-m-32-02.prereq.1: Wakatodzidza kamwe mamiriro ekumira 'kana mitsetse miviri yakamira, chigadzirwa che slopes dzayo i −1'
z-m-32-02.s.s1.prompt: Sezvo muenzaniso mumwe nemumwe unoratidzwa, sarudza kutonga nezvekuti mutemo waMinseo unoshanda sei.
z-m-32-02.s.s1.hint.0: Pamuenzaniso wega wega, tanga watarisa kana mitsetse yose ine slopes.
z-m-32-02.s.s1.hint.1: Rongedza mienzaniso kuita iyo apo mutemo unoshanda neiyo apo zvakaoma kutonga nemutemo, uye uinyore patafura.
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.0.info: Mutsetse l: y=3x−1, mutsetse m: y=−(1/3)x+2 (slope ye m i minus chitatu chimwe).
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.0.after: Chigadzirwa che slopes i 3×(−1/3)=−1, saka nemutemo waMinseo yakamira.
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Uku kungave kutonga kunobva pakuona kuti ma slopes akasiyana chete. Kuziva kana mitsetse yakamira, unofanira kutarisa kuti ma slopes anoenderana sei.
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Kutonga uku kunotarisa kuti ma slopes maviri anoenderana sei. Unogona kutaura chikonzero chawakashandisa mutemo kuchiitiko ichi here?
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Funga kana pane mutemo waunogona kushandisa kutonga kubva paruzivo rwuri mu equations, kunyangwe pasina mufananidzo.
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.1.info: Funga mutsetse l: x=2 (mutsetse wakamira) nemutsetse m: y=3 (mutsetse wakatwasuka).
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.1.ask: Mitsetse miviri iyi yakamira here? Chii chinoitika kumutemo waMinseo?
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.1.after: Mutsetse wakamira nemutsetse wakatwasuka zvinosangana pakona yakatwasuka, saka zvakamira. Asi mutsetse wakamira hauna slope, saka haugone kuutarisa nemutemo 'chigadzirwa i −1'. Mutemo waMinseo unoda mamiriro e 'kana mitsetse yose ine slopes'.
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Haina kumira. Haugone kuwanza ma slopes, saka chigadzirwa hachigone kuva −1
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Kutonga uku kunoshandura 'mhedzisiro yemutemo haisi −1' kuita 'havasi perpendicular'. Tanga wayeva kana idzi ari mitsara umo mutemo unogona kushandiswa.
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.1.o.b: Haugoni kusarudza kana vari perpendicular. Pasina slope haugoni kutonga
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Kusagona kushandisa mutemo kwakasiyana nekusagona kutonga. Kona inoumbwa nemutsara wakamira nemutsara wakatwasuka inogona kuongororwa nenzira imwe.
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Vari perpendicular. Asi mutsara wakamira hauna slope, saka haugoni kuutarisa nemutemo we product
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Kutonga uku kunofunga zvakaparadzana nezvemiganhu yemutemo nezvekona inoumbwa nemitsara miviri.
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.2.info: Mutsara l: 3x+4y−5=0, mutsara m: 4x−3y+7=0. (Ma coefficients e x ndi3 ne4, uye ma coefficients e y ndi4 ne−3.)
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.2.ask: Sarudza nzira imwe chete yakarurama yekutarisa kana mitsara miviri iri perpendicular.
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.2.after: Munzira a ma slopes ndi−3/4 ne4/3 uye product yavo ndi−1, saka vari perpendicular. Munzira c, 3×4+4×(−3)=0, saka vari perpendicularwo. Nzira c inogonawo kushandiswa sezvainoita kune x=2 (1x+0y−2=0) ne y=3 (0x+1y−3=0), sezvo 1×0+0×1=0. Munzira b, 3×4=12 haisi product yema slopes, saka haisi chikonzero chakarurama.
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Nyora zvakare ma equations ose maviri muchimiro y=mx+n, tsvaga ma slopes, uye uawedzere
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Iyi inzira yaunoshandisa mushure mekutarisa mamiriro emutemo (mitsara miviri ine ma slopes).
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Tarisa kana product yema coefficients e x iri −1
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Pamwe wakasiya kuti mutemo une chekuita ne slopes. Slope kukosha kumwe chete ne coefficient ye x here?
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Wedzera product yema coefficients e x ne product yema coefficients e y, uye utarise kana iri 0
z-m-32-02.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Iyi inzira inoedza kutonga pasina kutsvaga ma slopes. Zvakakodzera kuedza kana ichishandawo kumitsara senge x=2 ne y=3.
z-m-32-02.s.s1.reflect: Mushure mebvunzo yaDoyun, kutenda kwako nezvemutemo waMinseo kwakachinja sei? Wakarasa mutemo here, kana wakaisa mamiriro ekuti unogona kushandiswa rinhi? Kuti nzira mbiri dzakasvika kumhedziso imwe chete mudanho 3 kunokupa chivimbo chakadii?
z-m-32-02.s.s2.prompt: Nyora zvakare chirevo chaMinseo mumitsara miviri kana mitatu kuti chigone kutsanangurawo bvunzo yaDoyun. Nyorawo kuti mutemo uyu hauwo kushandiswa kumitsara ipi.
z-m-32-02.s.s2.hint.0: Tarisazve equation yemutsara waisagona kushandiswa nemutemo mudanho 2, uye unyore hunhu hwemutsara iwoyo nemashoko mashoma.
z-m-32-02.s.s2.hint.1: Nyora kuti mamiriro api anofanira kuiswa pamberi pemutsara unotanga ne 'Kana product iri −1.'
z-m-32-02.s.s2.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Kana mitsara miviri iri ..., kana iri perpendicular saka ...
z-m-32-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Mumutemo wakagadziriswa, ndakasiyanisa 'kana product iri −1, saka perpendicular' ne 'kana perpendicular, saka product iri −1' here?
z-m-32-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ndakataura zvakajeka mumhinduro yangu kana x=2 ne y=3 dziri perpendicular here?
z-m-32-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ndakataura chaizvo, nemashoko angu pachangu, mamiriro apo mutemo unoshanda here?
z-m-32-02.s.s2.model.0: Kana mitsara yose miviri ine ma slopes, kana iri perpendicular product yema slopes ndi−1, uye kana product iri −1 ari perpendicular. Asi mutsara wakamira senge x=2 hauna slope, saka haugoni kushandisa mutemo uyu, uye unofanira kubata zvakaparadzana kuti mutsara wakamira nemutsara wakatwasuka zviri perpendicular.
z-m-32-02.s.s2.model.1: Zvechokwadi kuti kana product iri −1 vari perpendicular. Asi pane nyaya apo mitsara iri perpendicular uye product haigoni kuwanikwa, semuenzaniso x=2 ne y=3. Mutsara wakamira une slope isina kutsanangurwa, saka siya nyaya iyoyo kunze kwemutemo uye uitarise zvakaparadzana.
z-m-32-02.s.s2.modelNote.1: Inotaura miganhu yemutemo nemhedziso yenyaya iyoyo (perpendicular).

z-m-32-05.prereq.2: Kutevedzana kwechikoro kunofungidzirwa: kunofungidzira kuti mudzidzi apedza math yechikoro chepakati (linear functions, Pythagorean theorem, zvimiro zvezvimiro) uye achangotanga yuniti ye equations yezvimiro ye Common Mathematics yechikoro chepamusoro. 'H1' i zita rekuoma nemwero wetsigiro yebasa iri rekugadzira, kwete giredhi mu curriculum.
z-m-32-05.title: Panzira, pane nzvimbo imwe chete here apo ratio yemwero iri 2:1?
z-m-32-05.topic: Interior ne exterior division points ye segment: poinzi ine ratio yakagara yemwero
z-m-32-05.goal: Tarisa kuti pamutsara, mapoinzi ane mwero kumapoinzi maviri une ratio yakagara anogona kuva mukati kana kunze, uye utsanangure kuti huwandu hwemapoinzi akadaro hunochinja sei kana wakadzora kuita segment kana kana ratio ikava 1:1.
z-m-32-05.material: Pa coordinate plane, funga grid square imwe se1 km. Fungidzira kuti nzira yakatwasuka inoenderera isingaperi kumativi ose maviri, uye panzira pane madhorobha maviri A(0, 0) ne B(6, 3). Unoda kuisa relay tower P panzira iyi kuti mwero wayo kuenda ku A uve nguva 2 mwero wayo kuenda ku B. Ndiko kuti, PA:PB=2:1. Soyun akati, "Ipoinzi inoparadzanisa segment AB neratio 2:1, saka ingori poinzi imwe, (4, 2)."
z-m-32-05.thinking.1: Kutsvaga iwe pachako mapoinzi akawanda anogutsa mamiriro
z-m-32-05.thinking.2: Kutsanangura kuti huwandu hunochinja sei kana mamiriro achichinja
z-m-32-05.prereq.0: Mwero pakati pemapoinzi maviri ne Pythagorean theorem
z-m-32-05.prereq.1: Kutaura poinzi iri pamutsara nema coordinates (middle school linear functions)
z-m-32-05.s.s1.prompt: Verenga chirevo chaSoyun uye usarudze kutonga kwako kwazvino. Nzvimbo dzingani panzira dzinogutsa mamiriro e P?
z-m-32-05.s.s1.hint.0: Paradzanisa nzira kuita zvikamu zvitatu, 'kunze kwe A', 'pakati pemadhorobha maviri', ne 'kunze kwe B', uye muchikamu chimwe nechimwe enzanisa kuti ndechipi chakareba pakati pe PA ne PB.
z-m-32-05.s.s1.hint.1: Muchikamu chimwe nechimwe, famisa P zvishoma nezvishoma uye ucherechedze kuti PA÷PB inochinja sei.
z-m-32-05.s.s1.r.a: Kutonga uku kwakangogamuchira chirevo chaSoyun sezvachakaita. Tarisa kana wakafunga kuti nzira haisi segment asi mutsara unoenderera usingaperi kumativi ose maviri.
z-m-32-05.s.s1.o.b: Nzvimbo 3 dzose (kunze kwe A, pakati pemadhorobha maviri, kunze kwe B)
z-m-32-05.s.s1.r.b: Kutonga uku kwakatora zvikamu zvitatu zvose zvenzira sevasarudzwa. Enzanisa kuti ndechipi chakareba pakati pe PA ne PB muchikamu chiri kunze kwe A.
z-m-32-05.s.s1.r.c: Kutonga uku kwakabva pakuenzanisa PA ne PB chikamu nechikamu panzira.
z-m-32-05.s.s1.o.d: Haugoni kusarudza huwandu hwenzvimbo kubva kuma coordinates oga
z-m-32-05.s.s1.r.d: Ma coordinates ose akapiwa, saka unogona kuongorora vasarudzwa uye usarudze huwandu. Unogona kutonga nekuenzanisa kureba chikamu nechikamu.
z-m-32-05.s.s1.explain: Pane nzvimbo imwe pakati pe A ne B nenzvimbo imwe kunze kwe B, saka nzvimbo 2 dzose. Kunze kwe A, B inogara iri kure kupfuura A, saka PA haigoni kuva nguva 2 PB.
z-m-32-05.s.s2.prompt: Isa mapoinzi 3 akasiyana P(x, y) panzira umo PA:PB iri 2:1 kana 1:2.
z-m-32-05.s.s2.hint.0: Taura poinzi iri panzira nechinoshanduka chimwe. Semuenzaniso, funga kuti unofanira kuenda nguva dzingani nzira kubva ku A kuenda ku B.
z-m-32-05.s.s2.hint.1: Deredza nzira kuita number line imwe ine A pa0 ne B pa3, tsvaga nzvimbo apo ratio yemwero miviri inokodzera mamiriro, wozozidzosera kunzira yekutanga.
z-m-32-05.s.s2.fail.c1: Haisi poinzi iri panzira. Shandisa ma coordinates e A ne B kutsvaga hukama hunoshanda pakati pe x-coordinate ne y-coordinate yepoinzi iri panzira.
z-m-32-05.s.s2.ok.c2: PA ndi nguva 2 PB, kana PB ndi nguva 2 PA.
z-m-32-05.s.s2.fail.c2: PA:PB haisi 2:1 kana 1:2. Tsvaga mwero mbiri uye uzvienzanise.
z-m-32-05.s.s2.explain: Kana yadzikiswa kuita number line ine A pa0 ne B pa3, ma P ane PA=2PB ndi2 (pakati pe A ne B) ne6 (kunze kwe B), uye ma P ane PB=2PA ndi1 (pakati pe A ne B) ne−3 (kunze kwe A). Kana adzoserwa kuma coordinates epanzira, ndi (4, 2), (12, 6), (2, 1), (−6, −3). (3, 1.5) ndiyo poinzi yepakati chaizvo pemisha miviri, saka ratio yayo ndi1:1.
z-m-32-05.s.s3.prompt: Pasi pemamiriro ekutanga (PA:PB=2:1), kana P yakadzorwa kuita segment AB, pane vasarudzwa vangani? Uye kana ratio ichichinjwa kuita 1:1, pane vasarudzwa vangani panzira (mutsara)? Nyora huwandu hwenzvimbo pamwe chete nechikonzero.
z-m-32-05.s.s3.hint.0: Tarisa kuti mapoinzi ari kugutsa mamiriro ekutanga PA:PB=2:1 ari pa segment AB ndeapi.
z-m-32-05.s.s3.hint.1: Kana ratio iri 1:1, isa P kunze kwe A uye uenzanise kuti ndechipi chakareba pakati pe PA ne PB.
z-m-32-05.s.s3.placeholder: Muenzaniso: Kana yakadzorwa kuita segment, ... Kana ratio iri 1:1, ... Nekuti ...
z-m-32-05.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ndakapindura nyaya yakadzorwa kuita segment nenyaya ye1:1 zvakaparadzana here?
z-m-32-05.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ndakatsanangura here, maererano nesaizi dzemwero, kuti nei pasina musarudzwa kunze kana ratio iri 1:1?
z-m-32-05.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Musiyano pakati pe 'mutsara' ne 'segment' wakajeka mutsananguro yangu here?
z-m-32-05.s.s3.model.0: Kana ukadzora P kuita segment AB, (4, 2) chete ndiyo inosara. Kana ratio iri 1:1, saka kunyange pamutsara pane poinzi imwe chete yepakati. Poinzi iri kunze inogara iri padhuze nedhorobha rimwe, saka mwero haugoni kuenzana.
z-m-32-05.s.s3.model.1: Mukati me segment ndiyo nzvimbo 1. Kana ratio iri 1:1, ingori poinzi yepakati yemadhorobha maviri, nzvimbo 1, uye kunze dhorobha rimwe rinogara riri padhuze, saka haagoni kuenzana.
z-m-32-05.s.s3.modelNote.1: Inopindura nyaya yakaganhurirwa nesegment nenyaya ye1:1 zvakaparadzana uye ichipa zvikonzero.
z-m-32-05.s.s3.model.2: Mukati mesegment pane poinzi imwe chete, (4,2), uye ne1:1 pane poinzi yepakati chete. Kunze, machinhambwe akasiyana.

z-m-32-06.prereq.2: Kutevedzana kwechikoro kunofungidzirwa: kunofungidzira kuti mudzidzi apedza math yechikoro chepakati (linear functions, Pythagorean theorem, zvimiro zvezvimiro) uye achangotanga yuniti ye equations yezvimiro ye Common Mathematics yechikoro chepamusoro. 'H1' i zita rekuoma nemwero wetsigiro yebasa iri rekugadzira, kwete giredhi mu curriculum.
z-m-32-06.title: Mitsara inodhirowa nekuchinja k inogona kupa mutsara wose unopfuura papoinzi iyoyo here?
z-m-32-06.topic: Mhuri yemitsara inopfuura papoinzi, nemutsara unoshayikwa
z-m-32-06.goal: Siyanisa kuvimba kunowanikwa kubva mumienzaniso yakawanda nekuongorora nyaya dzose, uye ushandise muenzaniso unopokana kutsanangura kuti nei mhuri yemitsara ine parameter k isingasanganisire mutsara wose unopfuura papoinzi.
z-m-32-06.material: Kune kukosha kwechokwadi kwega kwega kwe k, mutsara mumwe l_k: kx−y+2k+1=0 unosarudzwa. (l_k inoverengwa 'l sub k', uye equation inoverengwa 'k times x minus y plus 2k plus 1 equals zero'. Hapana mufananidzo.) Daeun akadhirowa mitsara y=1, y=x+3, y=−x−1 kune k=0, 1, −1, uye mitsara yose mitatu yakapfuura papoinzi (−2, 1). Daeun akati, "L_k yose inopfuura (−2, 1). Saka mutsara wose unopfuura (−2, 1) unofanira kuva pakati pe l_k."
z-m-32-06.thinking.0: Kusiyanisa kuwedzera mienzaniso nekuongorora nyaya dzose
z-m-32-06.thinking.1: Kuvaka iwe amene nyaya inoshayikwa (muenzaniso unopokana)
z-m-32-06.thinking.2: Kutsanangura miganhu yenzira yekuratidza chimwe chinhu
z-m-32-06.prereq.0: Revo yematambanuko ne y-intercept mu equation yemutsara y=mx+n
z-m-32-06.prereq.1: Kuisa ma coordinates epoinzi mu equation kuti uone kana poinzi iri pamutsara
z-m-32-06.s.s1.prompt: Daeun akava nechokwadi kuti 'l_k yose inopfuura (−2, 1)' mushure mekuona mitsara mitatu chete. Kuongorora kupi kwaizoita kuti kuvimba uku kuvimbike zvakanyanya?
z-m-32-06.s.s1.hint.0: Enzanisa kana 'zvakashanda katatu' ne 'zvinoshanda kune k yose' zvichireva chinhu chimwe chete.
z-m-32-06.s.s1.hint.1: Fungidzira kana kuisa kukosha kusingajairiki sa1000 kune k kwaizopa mugumisiro mumwe chete, uye ufunge kuti nei.
z-m-32-06.s.s1.o.a: Isa k=2, k=3, ne k=10 futi, dhirowa mitsara, uye uone kana ose achipfuura papoinzi
z-m-32-06.s.s1.r.a: Mienzaniso yakawanda inokuita kuti uvimbe zvakanyanya. Asi hauna kuongorora nhamba chaidzo dzose dzinogona kuva k.
z-m-32-06.s.s1.o.b: Kana k=0, mutsara y=1 unopfuura papoinzi (−2, 1), saka izvozvo zvakakwana
z-m-32-06.s.s1.r.b: Kutonga uku kwakatora chinhu chechokwadi kukosha kumwe kwe k sechechokwadi kune k yose.
z-m-32-06.s.s1.o.c: Isa poinzi (−2, 1) mu equation uye utarise kana equation ichishanda zvisinei nekukosha kwe k
z-m-32-06.s.s1.r.c: Pfungwa iyi ndeyekuongorora makosha ose pakarepo, uchichengeta k semavara.
z-m-32-06.s.s1.o.d: Kana mitsara yawakadhirowa ichitaridzika sekuti inosangana papoinzi imwe, izvozvo zvakakwana
z-m-32-06.s.s1.r.d: Kutonga uku kwakashandisa kuti zvinoonekwa sei nemaziso sehumbowo. Mufananidzo unoita kuti zvive zvakaoma kusiyanisa poinzi iri padhuze zvikuru nepoinzi imwe chete chaiyo.
z-m-32-06.s.s1.explain: Kuisa poinzi (−2, 1) mu equation kunopa k×(−2)−1+2k+1=0, iyo inoshanda zvisinei ne k. Kuunganidza mienzaniso yakawanda kunowedzera kuvimba kwako, asi chivimbiso chekuti chinoshanda kune k yose chinobva pakuongorora kunochengeta k semavara.
z-m-32-06.s.s1.acc.0: Kuunganidza mienzaniso yakawanda danho rekutanga rine musoro rinovaka kuvimba. Asi kuti uwane chivimbiso che 'k yose', unoda kuongorora kumwe chete kunochengeta k semavara.
z-m-32-06.s.s2.prompt: Edza pfungwa yechipiri yaDaeun, 'mutsara wose unopfuura (−2, 1) imwe l_k'. Isa mapoinzi 3 akasiyana (p, q) asiri pa l_k kune nhamba chaiyo ipi neipi yaunosarudza se k.
z-m-32-06.s.s2.hint.0: Gadzirisa poinzi imwe (p, q), iise mu equation, gadzira equation umo k chete inosara, uye utarise kana k ichigona kuwanikwa.
z-m-32-06.s.s2.hint.1: Wana kuti kune kukosha kwe p kupi izwi rine k, k(p+2), rinonyangarika.
z-m-32-06.s.s2.ok.c1: Iyi poinzi isiri pa l_k zvisinei nokuti unosarudza k ipi.
z-m-32-06.s.s2.fail.c1: Poinzi iyi iri pa l_k kana ukasarudza k yakarurama. Isa ma coordinates epoinzi mu equation uye uitore seequation mu k. Rinhi apo zvisingagoneki kuwana k?
z-m-32-06.s.s2.explain: Kuisa poinzi (p, q) mu equation kunopa k(p+2)=q−1. Kana p=−2, divi rekuruboshwe i0 zvisinei ne k, saka inoshanda chete kana q=1, uye kana q≠1 haishande kune k ipi neipi. Mapoinzi aya ose ari pamutsara x=−2. (0, 3) iri pa l_1 kana k=1, uye (−2, 1) iri pa l_k yose.
z-m-32-06.s.s3.prompt: Nyora zvaunganoudza Daeun. (1) Mutsara upi unopfuura papoinzi (−2, 1) asi usingagone kunyorwa se l_k? (2) Nei mutsara wakadaro uchishayikwa?

z-m-32-06.s.s3.hint.1: Nyora zvakare l_k muchimiro y=(…) uye uone kuti k inosarudza chii.

z-m-32-06.s.s3.model.0: Mutsara wakamira x=−2 unoshayikwa. l_k i y=k(x+2)+1, saka k inoita basa rematambanuko, uye mutsara wakamira hauna matambanuko, saka hapana k inogona kuugadzira.
z-m-32-06.s.s3.model.1: Mutsara x=−2, unopfuura (−2, 1) asi uri parallel ne y-axis, haubudi kune k ipi neipi. Izvi zvinokonzerwa nokuti chimiro y−1=k(x+2) chinomiririra mitsara ine matambanuko k chete.

z-m-32-01.title: Kana pane mapoindi matatu akapiwa, vertex yechina i yega here?
z-m-32-01.topic: Vertex yechina ye parallelogram (kuitsvaga nema coordinates)
z-m-32-01.goal: Shandisa ma coordinates kutarisa kuti, pa parallelogram ine mapoindi matatu akapiwa, pangava nema vertex echina akati wandei zvichienderana nekuti ibhii poindi yainotarisana nayo, uye utsanangure kuti chii chinochinja kana mapoindi matatu ari pamutsetse mumwe.
z-m-32-01.material: Pa coordinate plane pane mapoindi matatu A(0, 0), B(4, 1), C(1, 3). Unoda kugadzira parallelogram ine mapoindi matatu aya nepoindi imwe D semavertex. Kurongeka kwemazita emavertex hakugadzwi. Ndiko kuti, D inogona kutarisana ne A, B, kana C. Hayun akawana D=(5, 4) uye akati, "Iyi ndiyo poindi yechina inogoneka chete." (Parallelogram i chimiro chisina mapoindi mana ese pamutsetse mumwe. Sikweya imwe ye grid ine hurefu hwakafanana kunzira dzese.)
z-m-32-01.thinking.1: Kuvaka iwe pachako mhinduro dzakati wandei mukati memiganhu
z-m-32-01.thinking.2: Kutsvaga mamiriro apo inoshanda (mapoindi matatu haasi pamutsetse mumwe)

z-m-32-01.s.s1.prompt: Kana wakaverenga pakutanga chirevo chaHayun, unotonga sei? Sarudza chakanyanya kuswedera pane zvaunofunga zvino. (Zvakanaka kukanganisa. Uchazviedza iwe pachako munhanho dziri pazasi.)
z-m-32-01.s.s1.hint.0: Dhonza A, B, ne C semapoindi pa coordinate plane uye ubatanidze mapoindi matatu kudhonza triangle.
z-m-32-01.s.s1.hint.1: Mu parallelogram, madiagonal maviri anosangana pakati pewo. Kana wasarudza kuti D iri pakatarisana neimwe yemapoindi A, B, C, dhonza kuti nzvimbo ye D yaizosiyana sei.
z-m-32-01.s.s1.r.a: Kutonga uku kunofungidzira kuti kana mapoindi matatu akagadzwa, poindi yekupedzisira yakagadzwawo. Asi dambudziko rakataura kuti D iri pakatarisana nepoindi ipi here?
z-m-32-01.s.s1.r.b: Uku kutonga kunoti mapoindi maviri chete angatarisana. Verenga kuti mangani pa A, B, C angatarisana ne D.
z-m-32-01.s.s1.o.c: Hatigone kuziva nhamba kubva pama coordinates bedzi
z-m-32-01.s.s1.r.c: Ma coordinates ese akapiwa, saka unogona kuverenga nhamba. Unogona kufunga kuti yaizochinja sei kana nzvimbo dzemapoindi dzaisiyana.
z-m-32-01.s.s1.r.d: Uku kutonga kwakaitwa nekuverenga uchichinja poindi inotarisana ne D. Munhanho iri pazasi, tichavagadzira isu pachedu kutarisa kana nhamba iyi yakarurama.
z-m-32-01.s.s1.explain: Kana mapoindi matatu asiri pamutsetse mumwe, chiitiko apo D inotarisana ne A, chiitiko apo inotarisana ne B, uye chiitiko apo inotarisana ne C chimwe nechimwe chinogadzira parallelogram imwe, saka pane 3. (5, 4) i imwe yazvo. Munhanho inotevera uchazvivaka iwe pachako kuti utarise.
z-m-32-01.s.s2.prompt: Isa ma coordinates (x, y) 3 akasiyana e D. Mapoindi anogadzira parallelogram pamwe ne A, B, ne C chete ndiwo anogamuchirwa. ((5, 4) yaHayun inoverengwa seimwe yazvo.)
z-m-32-01.s.s2.hint.0: Dhonza chimiro chinobatanidza mapoindi mana nenzira ne D=(5, 4) yaHayun, uye utsvage kuti ipi pa A, B, C inotarisana ne D.
z-m-32-01.s.s2.hint.1: Cherekedza kuti zvikamu zviviri zvinobatanidza mavertex akatarisana zvinoenderana sei, uye uchinje hukama uhwu kuita kuverenga nema coordinates.
z-m-32-01.s.s2.ok.c1: Izvi zvinogadzira parallelogram apo D inotarisana neimwe ye A, B, ne C.
z-m-32-01.s.s2.fail.c1: Poindi iyi haigadziri parallelogram. Tarisa chimiro chezvikamu zviviri zvinobatanidza mapeya emavertex akatarisana.
z-m-32-01.s.s2.explain: Kana D inotarisana ne A i (5, 4), kana inotarisana ne B i (−3, 2), uye kana inotarisana ne C i (3, −2). Munzira ina dzese, zvikamu zviviri zvinobatanidza mapeya maviri emavertex akatarisana zvinosangana pakati pazvo.
z-m-32-01.s.s3.prompt: Kana mapoindi matatu ari pamutsetse mumwe, sa A(0, 0), P(1, 1), Q(2, 2), pane mapoindi mangani anogoneka e D? Nyora nhamba nechikonzero mumutsara mumwe kana miviri.
z-m-32-01.s.s3.hint.0: Dhonza A, P, ne Q pa coordinate plane uye utarise kana mapoindi matatu aya achigadzira triangle.
z-m-32-01.s.s3.hint.1: Dhonza chimiro chinogadzirwa nemapoindi mana kana D iri pamutsetse uye kana iri kunze kwemutsetse.
z-m-32-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Zvose 'nhamba' ne 'chikonzero' zvakajeka mumhinduro yangu here?
z-m-32-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ndakabatanidza chokwadi chekuti mapoindi matatu haagadzire triangle nemhedziso yekuti hapana parallelogram inogoneka here?
z-m-32-01.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Ndakafungawo nezvezviitiko zvose zviviri apo D iri pamutsetse nepo iri kunze kwemutsetse here?
z-m-32-01.s.s3.model.0: Kana mapoindi matatu ari pamutsetse mumwe, zvisinei kuti uisa D kupi haugone kugadzira parallelogram. Mapoindi matatu anofanira kugadzira triangle kuti zviitiko 3, nekuchinja poindi inotarisana, ziite.
z-m-32-01.s.s3.model.1: A, P, ne Q zviri mumutsetse wakatwasuka, saka hapana triangle inogadzirwa, uye kana D iri pamutsetse kana kunze kwawo, hapana parallelogram inogadzirwa, saka nhamba i 0.
z-m-32-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Zvakanaka kuti wakapatsanura D kuita iri pamutsetse neiri kunze kwemutsetse.
z-m-32-01.s.s3.model.2: Kwose kwakaiswa D, haigadziri parallelogram. Kana A, P, Q zviri pamutsetse mumwe (y=x), hapana triangle inogadzirwa, saka nhamba i 0.

z-m-32-03.title: Equation yedenderedzwa rakafambiswa inoratidzika yakashata: yakatsauka papi?
z-m-32-03.goal: Tsvaga kukanganisa mumhinduro ye equation yechimiro chakafambiswa, apo nzira yekufamba yakashandiswa zvakadzoserwa, uye usiyanise kutarisa kunogona kuratidza kukanganisa nekusingagoni.
z-m-32-03.material: Seoyun akagadzirisa equation yedenderedzwa C: (x+1)²+(y−2)²=9 rakafambiswa ne+3 nenzira ye x ne−4 nenzira ye y, sezvakaratidzwa pazasi. (+3 nenzira ye x zvinoreva mayuniti 3 kurudyi, uye −4 nenzira ye y zvinoreva mayuniti 4 kuzasi. Mutemo wekufambisa poinzi imwe ndewekuti (x, y) inoenda ku (x+3, y−4). Equation yedenderedzwa C inoverengwa se 'x plus 1 squared plus y minus 2 squared equals 9'.)
z-m-32-03.thinking.0: Kutsvaga mutsara apo kukanganisa kwakatanga mumhinduro
z-m-32-03.thinking.2: Kushandisa equation yakagadziriswa kugadzira kufamba kunogutsa mamiriro
z-m-32-03.prereq.0: Zvinoreva equation yedenderedzwa (x−a)²+(y−b)²=r² (pakati (a, b), radius r)
z-m-32-03.prereq.1: Kufambisa poinzi (x, y) ne p nenzira ye x ne q nenzira ye y kunopa (x+p, y+q)
z-m-32-03.s.s1.prompt: Sarudza mutsara wekutanga mumhinduro yaSeoyun unotadza.
z-m-32-03.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga mutsara mumwe nemumwe uye utarise, mumwe panguva, kana unotevera zvakasikwa kubva pamhedzisiro yemutsara wapfuura.
z-m-32-03.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa poinzi yaunowana nekufambisa pakati pedenderedzwa C nemutemo wenyaya nepakati pemutsara wekupedzisira waSeoyun.
z-m-32-03.s.s1.line.0: Tsvaga equation yechimiro chinowanikwa nekufambisa denderedzwa C ne+3 nenzira ye x ne−4 nenzira ye y.
z-m-32-03.s.s1.line.1: Kana poinzi (x, y) iri pachimiro yafambiswa, inova (x+3, y−4), saka tsiva x ne x+3 uye y ne y−4 mu equation.
z-m-32-03.s.s1.line.4: Saka idenderedzwa rine pakati (−4, 6) ne radius 3.
z-m-32-03.s.s1.explain: Rakatsauka pamutsara 2. Poinzi (X, Y) iri pachimiro chakafambiswa ipoinzi (X−3, Y+4) yechimiro chekutanga yakafambira ipapo, saka X−3 ne Y+4 dzinofanira kuenda panzvimbo dze x ne y mu equation yekutanga. Equation yaSeoyun inotumira pakati ku (−4, 6), asi kufambisa pakati pekutanga (−1, 2) ne (+3, −4) kunopa (2, −2). Kutarisa: poinzi (−1, 5) iri padenderedzwa C inofamba ichienda ku (2, 1), uye kuisa poinzi iyi mu equation itsva yaSeoyun kunopa 6²+(−5)²=61, kwete 9. Mitsara 3 kusvika ku5 inongotevera kubva pamhedzisiro yemutsara 2.
z-m-32-03.s.s2.prompt: Mushure mekuti Seoyun apedza mhinduro, kutarisa kupi kwaibatsira kuona kukanganisa pakarepo? Sarudza kutarisa kwose kunogona kuratidza kukanganisa mumhinduro iyi chaizvo.
z-m-32-03.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora kuti kukosha kupi mu equation itsva yaSeoyun kusina kuchinja kubva pa equation yekutanga.
z-m-32-03.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kana kukanganisa kuri kwenzvimbo kana kwesaizi, uye uenzanise kana kutarisa kumwe nekumwe kuchitarisa kukosha uko.
z-m-32-03.s.s2.o.a: Tarisa kana divi rekurudyi re equation itsva richiri 9 uye radius ichiri 3
z-m-32-03.s.s2.r.a: Mumhinduro iyi radius yakafanana nekare, saka kutarisa uku oga hakuratidzi kukanganisa. Funga kana kutarisa uku kuchitarisa chimiro chechimiro kana nzvimbo yacho.
z-m-32-03.s.s2.o.b: Fambisa pakati pedenderedzwa C nemutemo mumwe chete uye uuenzanise nepakati mu equation itsva
z-m-32-03.s.s2.r.b: Pfungwa iyi ndeyekuverenga zvakananga nzvimbo mushure mekufamba nemutemo wekufamba uye kuenzanisa.
z-m-32-03.s.s2.o.c: Wedzera equation itsva uye utarise kana ma coefficients e x² ne y² achiri 1 ose
z-m-32-03.s.s2.r.c: Ma coefficients haachinji pasi pe translation, saka anoramba akafanana kunyange mumhinduro yakashata. Kutarisa uku hakuoni nzira kana saizi yekufamba.
z-m-32-03.s.s2.o.d: Fambisa poinzi imwe iri padenderedzwa C nemutemo mumwe chete uye uiise mu equation itsva kuona kana ichikodzera
z-m-32-03.s.s2.r.d: Pfungwa iyi ndeyekuedza zvakananga kana poinzi yapinda poinzi yechimiro chekutanga inogutsa equation itsva.
z-m-32-03.s.s2.explain: Equation itsva yaSeoyun ine radius imwe chete nema coefficients e x² ne y² akafanana nekare, saka kutarisa a ne c kunopfuura. Kukanganisa kuri mu 'nzvimbo mushure mekufamba', saka kutarisa b ne d, kunofambisa pakati kana poinzi iri pachimiro nemutemo mumwe chete uye kuenzanisa ne equation itsva, kunoratidza kukanganisa.
z-m-32-03.s.s3.prompt: Wakafambisa denderedzwa C ne p nenzira ye x ne q nenzira ye y (radius inoramba iri 3 mushure mekufamba), uye rakava denderedzwa rinopfuura napa origin (0, 0). Isa (p, q) 3 dzakasiyana dzinogoneka. (Ma decimals anobvumirwa.)
z-m-32-03.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga wanyora pakati pakati, iri pakati (−1, 2) pedenderedzwa C pakafambiswa ne p ne q, se p ne q.
z-m-32-03.s.s3.hint.1: Shandisa kuna pakati pakati nekuorigin chokwadi chekuti poinzi imwe neimwe iri padenderedzwa iri pamwero wakatarwa kubva pakati.
z-m-32-03.s.s3.fail.c1: Denderedzwa rakafambiswa harifuuri napa origin. Nyora pakati pakati se p ne q uye utarise mwero kuenda ku origin.
z-m-32-03.s.s3.explain: Pakati pakati ndi (−1+p, 2+q), uye kuti origin ive padenderedzwa, mwero pakati pe origin napakati pakati unofanira kuva radius 3. Ndiko kuti, (p−1)²+(q+2)²=9. Mhinduro dze integer ndi (4, −2), (−2, −2), (1, 1), (1, −5), uye pane mhinduro dze decimal zvakare. Kune kufamba (3, −4) munyaya yekutanga, pakati pakati ndi (2, −2), uye mwero wayo kuenda ku origin ndi √8, saka denderedzwa harifuuri napa origin.

z-m-32-04.title: Ruzivo rwekuti 'vanobatana papoinzi imwe chete' rwakakwana here?
z-m-32-04.topic: Nzvimbo yemadenderedzwa maviri nemwero pakati pemapakati awo
z-m-32-04.goal: Dzidza kuti ruzivo rwekuti madenderedzwa maviri anosangana papoinzi imwe haruiti kuti mwero pakati pemapakati utarwe sekukosha kumwe chete, taura kuti ruzivo rupi rwekuwedzera rwunodiwa, uye utsanangure renji remwero apo anosangana pamapoinzi maviri.
z-m-32-04.material: Gadheni rakatenderera A rine pakati pa origin O(0, 0) ne radius 3 (unit: m). Se equation, ndi x²+y²=9. Gadheni B idenderedzwa rine radius 5 (unit: m), uye nzvimbo yepakati payo haisati yasarudzwa. Plan inongoti 'mitsara yemiganhu yemagadheni maviri inosangana papoinzi imwe chete'. Jion akati, "Vanobatana papoinzi imwe chete, saka mwero d pakati pemapakati maviri ndi3+5=8." (Fungidzira muganhu semutsara usina kukora. Kana madenderedzwa maviri ari kure, kana rimwe denderedzwa riri mukati mekumwe zvizere, mitsara yemiganhu yavo haisangani.)
z-m-32-04.thinking.0: Kutonga kana ruzivo rwakakwana uye kutaura chakashaikwa
z-m-32-04.thinking.1: Kugadzira iwe pachako marudzi akasiyana anogutsa mamiriro
z-m-32-04.prereq.0: Equation yedenderedzwa x²+y²=r² nemwero pakati pemapoinzi maviri
z-m-32-04.prereq.1: Zvinoreva kuti mwero pakati papoinzi iri padenderedzwa napakati radius
z-m-32-04.s.s1.prompt: Ruzivo rwekuti 'mitsara yemiganhu inosangana papoinzi imwe chete' runogona kutara d sekukosha kumwe chete here? Sarudza kutonga kunokodzera zvakanyanya.
z-m-32-04.s.s1.hint.0: Dhirowa denderedzwa re radius 3, wozodhirowa pikicha imwe ine denderedzwa re radius 5 richirubata kubva kunze nepimwe richirubata kubva mukati.
z-m-32-04.s.s1.hint.1: Mupikicha imwe neimwe, nyora kureba uye uenzanise kuti mwero pakati pemapakati maviri une hukama sei nema radii maviri.
z-m-32-04.s.s1.o.a: d inogona kuva 8 kana 2, makosha maviri, saka haina kutarwa seimwe
z-m-32-04.s.s1.r.a: Kutonga uku kwakafunga kuti nzira yekubata inoparadzana kuita mbiri.
z-m-32-04.s.s1.r.b: Kutonga uku kwakafunga chete nyaya apo madenderedzwa maviri anobatana kubva kunze. Dhirowa kana nyaya apo denderedzwa rimwe rinobata rimwe kubva mukati inosanganawo papoinzi imwe.
z-m-32-04.s.s1.r.c: Kutonga uku kwakafungidzira chete nyaya apo denderedzwa diki rinobata denderedzwa guru kubva mukati. Madenderedzwa anobatana kubva kunze anosangana papoinzi imwe zvakare.
z-m-32-04.s.s1.o.d: Ruzivo rwakawanda runodiwa, saka haugoni kutaura kukosha kwe d
z-m-32-04.s.s1.r.d: Kutonga kwekuti zvakawanda zvinodiwa kunoshanda. Asi funga kana unogona kutaurawo kuti ruzivo rupi runodiwa uye, zvichienderana naro, d ichava rimwe re makosha mangani.
z-m-32-04.s.s1.explain: Pane nyaya mbiri apo madenderedzwa maviri anosangana papoinzi imwe chete. Kana achibatana kubva kunze, d=3+5=8, uye kana denderedzwa diki A rikabata mukati medenderedzwa guru B, d=5−3=2. Saka unoda kuziva zvakawanda nezve 'kuti anobatana nenzira ipi' kuti d itarwe sekukosha kumwe chete.
z-m-32-04.s.s1.acc.0: Mhedziso yekuti ruzivo harwuna kukwana yakarurama. Kuenda danho rimwe mberi, kana uchiziva 'kana anobatana kubva kunze kana kubva mukati', d inotarwa kuva 8 kana 2.
z-m-32-04.s.s2.prompt: Sarudza pakati (x, y) pegadheni B uye ugadzire layout umo mitsara miviri yemiganhu inosangana papoinzi imwe chete. Wapedza kana waisa ma layouts maviri ane mwero kubva ku origin kuenda pakati pe B wakasiyana.
z-m-32-04.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora square yemwero kubva ku origin kuenda pakati se x ne y.
z-m-32-04.s.s2.hint.1: Tanga wasarudza mwero kune nyaya mbiri dzekusangana papoinzi imwe, wozosarudza poinzi imwe kune mwero mumwe nemumwe.
z-m-32-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Mitsara miviri yemiganhu inosangana papoinzi imwe chete.
z-m-32-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Neiyi pakati, mitsara miviri yemiganhu haisangani papoinzi imwe (haisangani, kana inosangana pamapoinzi maviri). Enzanisa mwero kubva ku origin kuenda pakati nema radii maviri.
z-m-32-04.s.s2.explain: Kana mwero kubva ku origin kuenda pakati uri 8, vanobatana kubva kunze (semuenzaniso (8, 0)), uye kana uri 2, vanobatana kubva mukati (semuenzaniso (0, 2)). Kana ma distances akaenzana (semuenzaniso (8, 0) ne (0, 8)), ndiro rudzi rwemuiti rwakafanana, saka averenge se imwe.
